subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification / ACME Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: James Porter <james.porter@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from discovery call — ACME Health

Hi James —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

- Key decision criteria I heard: predictable latency under 100ms for patient-facing features, clear audit logs for data access, and contractual data residency for PHI.
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Lisa Chen (Security), Procurement team (procurement@acmehealth.com), and your CIO as the economic buyer.

Next steps we suggest:
1) Share our security questionnaire so Lisa and team can scope systems in/out. (Attached).
2) Kickoff meeting with Lisa + procurement to confirm timeline and procurement steps. We can do a 30–45 min session.
3) Provide SOC 2 and encryption docs for review.

Can you confirm:
- The right security contact(s) (is Lisa the primary?)
- Systems in scope (EHR integration, patient portal, analytics)?
- Preferred timeline for procurement/PO?

Attaching: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (fillable)

Thanks — happy to loop in Rishi for any pricing/contract questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf]

From: James Porter <james.porter@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from discovery call — ACME Health

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the stakeholder list:
- Lisa Chen (Head of InfoSec) — primary for security questionnaire
- Procurement inbox (procurement@acmehealth.com) — contracting and PO
- Michael Ruiz (CIO) — economic buyer, will make final approval

Systems we expect to include in scope: patient portal (web + mobile), EHR sync (FHIR interface), and anonymized analytics pipeline. We would like to exclude internal clinical research datasets for now.

Timeline: procurement will aim to have terms + PO within 4–6 weeks after security signoff. We typically require SOC reports and encryption details up front.

I'll ask Lisa to review the questionnaire this week. Attaching our procurement checklist so you can see required fields.

Thanks,
James
Director, Product — ACME Health
[Attachment: ACME_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: James Porter <james.porter@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from discovery call — ACME Health

Great — thanks James. 

Lisa / team — quick note on what we typically provide for initial reviews to speed procurement/security:
- SOC 2 Type II report (we can provide the latest redacted report)
- Encryption at-rest and in-transit details + KMS integration notes
- Data flow diagram showing where PHI is stored/processed and any third-party services
- Our standard DPA + sample SOW and pricing worksheet

A couple of clarifying questions to help scope the questionnaire:
- For patient portal: will Redwood be processing PHI (names, MRNs) or only pseudonymized tokens?
- For EHR sync: is the integration direct to your hosted EHR or via an existing middleware layer?
- Any regulatory constraints we should be aware of beyond HIPAA (state-level, international)?

Proposed kickoff: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 at 11:00am PT — 30 minutes to review questionnaire and agree on systems in scope. If that works I will send a calendar invite and share the SOC2 and DPA.

Attachments: SOC2-Type-II-Redwood-2025.pdf (redacted), SOW-Redwood-ACME-draft.docx (template)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: SOC2-Type-II-Redwood-2025.pdf, SOW-Redwood-ACME-draft.docx]

Marissa —

The proposed time on the 28th works for Lisa and procurement. A couple of quick items before the kickoff: 
- Procurement wants a indication if Redwood requires any inbound firewall rules or dedicated IPs for the EHR sync. Please have technical notes ready.
- We need to confirm data residency: anything that touches PHI must remain in US regions.
- Procurement would like to see an example PO language for monthly committed capacity and overage handling.

I'll have Lisa start the questionnaire review — she may fill in early answers and flag technical owners.

Regards,
James
